name: Lokalise targets audit - review ingest
description: Hourly: when Maria reacts ✅ on an audit summary, reads the review sheet and stores decisions as precedent. On new sheets every Rejected row needs a reason; if any is missing nothing is stored and a reminder is posted once.

parameters.text: =Review ingested: {{ $('Build decisions').all().filter(i => i.json.decision === 'approved').length }} approved · {{ $('Build decisions').all().filter(i => i.json.decision === 'rejected').length }} rejected

parameters.content:
## Targets audit - review ingest

Hourly on weekdays. For each audit run whose review sheet is not ingested yet, checks the #i18n-team summary for a :white_check_mark: from Maria. When found, reads EVERY tab of the sheet except _ids (one tab per language since 2026-10-07; older sheets have one Findings tab). **Decision** dropdown: Approved / Rejected; blank = not reviewed and skipped; deleted rows = rejected. Older sheets: Approve? (x) = approved, unmarked = rejected; Reject? (x) = rejected. Decisions go to targets_audit_feedback and are used as precedent by the nightly audit. One sheet per run.

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/' + $('Pick reviewed sheet').first().json.sheet_id + '/values:batchGet?' + ($json.sheets || []).map(function (s) { return s.properties.title; }).filter(function (t) { return t !== '_ids'; }).map(function (t) { return 'ranges=' + encodeURIComponent("'" + t.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"); }).join('&') }}

parameters.text: ={{ ':warning: ' + $('Build decisions').first().json.count + ' row(s) are marked *Rejected* without a reason. A reason is required for every rejection: fill in the _Reason (required if Rejected)_ column (empty ones are highlighted in red). Nothing has been stored yet; the review is picked up automatically within the hour once every rejection has a reason.' + String.fromCharCode(10) + $('Build decisions').first().json.missing.join(String.fromCharCode(10)) + ($('Build decisions').first().json.more ? String.fromCharCode(10) + '… and ' + $('Build decisions').first().json.more + ' more' : '') }}

activeVersion.name: Reason mandatory for Rejected rows
activeVersion.description: Sheets with the 'Reason (required if Rejected)' column: if any Rejected row has no reason, nothing is stored, the run is flagged needs_reason, and a one-time reminder listing the rows is posted in the summary thread. Re-checked hourly until every rejection has a reason. Older sheets keep their previous behaviour.
